variants.A:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square mobile puzzle game app icon, one complete icon only, 1024x1024, opaque full bleed, no rounded outer corners or white mockup margins.
Design A, 'Curious COghe'. Create a premium polished stylized 3D icon for an affectionate alien laboratory puzzle game. The ONLY character is COghe: an original small glossy near-black liquid organism, asymmetric plump fluid droplet body, connected soft lobes, NO eyes, NO face, NO mouth, NO teeth, NO ears. Not a humanoid. Its inquisitive emotion is entirely in body language: main liquid mass leaning forward with a softly raised rounded lobe and two flexible elegant tendrils, one gently curling towards the viewer, the other sweeping up. Silhouette cute, lively, substantial, not scary, not spiky. The tendrils are part of the same liquid body. COghe takes up 75 percent of the image and is clearly recognizable at tiny thumbnail size. A subtle transparent glass surface under it and a single faint beveled glass edge behind hint at its laboratory habitat; not a full complex scene.
Composition: intimate slightly low three-quarter portrait of the whole liquid mass, off-center asymmetry balanced inside central 80 percent safe area. Strong simple silhouette, generous separation from background, large coherent shapes. Background warm pale ivory at upper left blending to soft sage-mint at lower right. Dark charcoal body with broad controlled warm white and pale cyan studio reflections that describe soft fluid volume, never two dots that look like eyes. Restrained mint edge light, soft contact shadow. Warm inviting clean high-end casual puzzle visual style, not photorealistic, no grunge, no laboratory clutter, no mechanism, no tiny details, no disconnected mini blobs. No Marvel/film imagery. NO text, letters, typography, logos, badges, numbers, watermark, borders. The final image itself is the finished app-icon art, not a presentation board.
variants.B:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square mobile puzzle game app icon, one complete icon only, 1024x1024, opaque full bleed, no rounded outer corners or white mockup margins.
Design B, 'COghe escapes'. Create a premium polished stylized 3D icon for an affectionate alien laboratory puzzle game. Show ONE original glossy black liquid alien elastically squeezing through a round hole in a clear glass lab pane towards the viewer. One continuous plump flowing body, a narrow waist in the aperture and a larger rounded front lobe emerging, two short expressive curling liquid tendrils reaching out in a cheerful triumphant pose. NO eyes, no face, no mouth, no teeth, no ears, no humanoid anatomy. The glossy near-black fluid, broad clean highlights and expressive asymmetric silhouette ARE the character identity.
The perfectly circular aperture is seen as a diagonal ellipse in three-quarter view; thin flush sage-mint edging around the actual hole, no giant portal or neon effects. Make the glass pane discernible through a pale blue transparent plane and only TWO cropped bevel edge glints, no cage grid and no apparatus. Clearly show body passing through opening, not sitting next to it, floating before a ring, or broken into separate fragments. All tissue is connected through the hole. Dynamic diagonal sweep from upper left/back through hole towards bottom right/front. Creature occupies at least two thirds of image, aperture frames its narrow waist, central subject must survive a circular icon crop.
Warm ivory and soft pale-aqua backdrop, glass mint accent, near-black liquid, limited palette. Soft warm directional key plus cool fill, broad creamy reflections on liquid, gentle depth shadow, no chrome noise. Large immediately readable forms and minimal background, premium clean cute hybrid-casual puzzle art, rounded soft geometry. No arrow, no UI, no extra props, no hands, no scientific labels, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no outer border. No Marvel imagery. The image itself is the finished app-icon art, not a presentation or screenshot.
variants.C:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one finished square mobile puzzle game app icon for COghe, full-bleed opaque background, no outer border, no mockup, no text. This is OPTION C, an additional deliberately monster-like interpretation authorized by the game's creator.
Design an ORIGINAL charismatic black liquid alien whose glossy material, white slanted eye patches and mischievous toothy expression evoke a symbiotic comic-book monster, while clearly belonging to a friendly clean alien-laboratory puzzle game. It is COghe, not a copy of any film character. No spider emblem, no costume, no human torso, no Marvel logo. Keep its existing plump asymmetric ink-drop body, organic fluid lobes and two curling tendrils.
Composition: extreme readable hero portrait, the creature occupying 75 percent of the square; its fluid main body rises into a temporary broad rounded head, turned in a slight curious three-quarter tilt toward the viewer. Two large creamy white luminous-looking eye shapes, unequal curved teardrop shapes narrowing inward with expressive playful brows formed from the black liquid; do NOT reproduce Venom's exact eye outline. A broad cheeky grin with a small handful of smoothly stylized ivory triangular teeth and one SHORT muted coral tongue curling at the corner. The expression must be cheeky, clever and endearing, not a snarling horror monster. No realistic gums, drool, gore or terrifying anatomical detail. A glossy liquid lower body with two elegant soft curling tendrils creates the recognizable COghe silhouette, no disconnected fragments.
Warm pale ivory background with a soft sage mint gradient, a quiet transparent pale cyan lab-glass plane behind, cropped slender glass bevel glints at the two lower corners only. Broad premium softbox reflections on near-black wet skin, restrained cool cyan rim light, warm soft key, clear large highlights describing fluid volume. Glossy stylized 3D, exquisite rounded forms, crisp app-icon polish, simple uncluttered color design, high subject/background contrast at 48 pixels. No neon, no purple darkness, no industrial clutter. Keep eyes, mouth and essential tendrils within central 80 percent for rounded-square or circle crop. All corners filled with background. NO text, NO labels, NO watermark.
